content:
Hello everyone,
 
This is my second contribution, following my first successful project: Budget Tracker from the Clash of Code game. First of all, I want to thank you all for the amazing support you gave for my very first contribution — it really meant a lot!
 
For List It: this is a classic puzzle where you can learn and practice working with arrays/lists,  trim() ,  parseInt() , and how to store and process data while keeping the original information intact.
 
This idea was inspired by my own cravings 😆 and the delicious delicacies here in the Philippines. I hope you guys enjoy solving it and find it helpful for learning. Please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions — thank you so much for your time and continued support!
